note: Overrides on top of the frozen harness/config.json (v0.2.3). Every key not listed here (models, digests, Ollama version, inference options, timeout, retries, max actions, receiver) comes unchanged from harness/config.json.
seed_rule: seed = 20261119 + 1000*rep + case_index (0-based line number in harness/cases/main.jsonl); used for all four stage-2 conditions and the receiver call of a trial; stage 1 is not called (its stored output from the source run is reused)

attack_selection.rule: numpy.random.default_rng(20261119).choice(<the 25 attack case_ids in main.jsonl file order>, 5, replace=False), listed in file order
